entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help, or 'Sales' for new orders.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I need to make a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF77812.

Thank you, Sarah. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand, delivered on December 20th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?
Oh, no, there's nothing wrong with it. It's just... I haven't even opened the box. Things just got complicated right after it arrived.
I understand. I do see that it was delivered 34 days ago, which is outside our standard 20-day window for preference-based returns. Can you tell me a little more about what happened?
I just feel so awful about this. I've been a loyal customer for years. Right after it came, I had a medical emergency and had to go to the hospital. It was all so sudden.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope you're recovering well.

Thank you. It's been slow. I ended up needing surgery, and my husband is on a military deployment, so I've been handling everything alone. The band has just been sitting here, and honestly, with all the medical bills, I really needed this money back. I completely forgot about the return window.
Sarah, thank you for sharing that with me. Given the situation with the hospital and the surgery, let me double-check our policies. Please hold one moment.
Okay, thank you.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your account and our internal knowledge base. It states here that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery as long as they are in original condition.
Really? Oh, thank goodness.

Yes. Since you received it 34 days ago, you are still well within that timeframe. I can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund. I truly am sorry to hear about your medical emergency, and I'm glad I can get this sorted out for you.
That is such a relief. You have no idea. Thank you so, so much, Diana.

You're most welcome, Sarah. I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method in 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. I hope your recovery continues to go smoothly. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
